The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The kernel signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm faking 192 aliases needs 192 separate boarding logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The canyon ledger records each payment, the lotus window resets the board, and 192 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
